name: Tamer
description: Finds the tones that ring out above the bed of sound around them, as they happen, and turns only those down. Leaves clean notes alone. Adds no delay.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How much of what stands out is taken away. Low only touches the worst tones; all the way up levels every peak with the sound around it. Zero turns it off.

params.name: Sharpness
params.description: How narrow the cuts are. Up picks out single ringing tones and leaves their neighbours; down evens out broad humps, more like a tone control.

params.name: Time
params.description: How fast a cut comes in. Short catches the harsh start of a sound; long only acts on what stays. It lets go four times slower.

params.name: From
params.description: The bottom of the range that is worked on. Everything below is left alone, so raise it to keep the weight of a sound out of reach. Under 120 Hz nothing is ever touched.

params.name: To
params.description: The top of the range that is worked on. Everything above is left alone, so lower it to keep the air of a sound out of reach.

params.name: Listen
params.description: On plays only what is being taken away, so the settings can be tuned by ear. Turn it off again to hear the result.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. In the family of the resonance suppressors: a spectral compressor keyed on each band's level against the sound on both sides of it, with the cuts made by minimum-phase peaking filters so that it adds no latency. Not a model of any product.
